steps.name: Composed Soldier
steps.text: How is the Generalik?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: He's sleeping.

steps.name: Composed Soldier
steps.text: Is he out of danger?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Composed Soldier
steps.text: In that case, you should get some rest too. I will keep watch.

steps.name: Composed Soldier
steps.text: Thank you for all that you've done for the general.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: No... I simply try to give comfort to everyone who needs it.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I'm not tired. I think there might be other people here who need my help.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I would like to go out and find them.

steps.name: Composed Soldier
steps.text: We cannot deny your requests... but the Generalik's orders were for you to remain by his side.

steps.name: Composed Soldier
steps.text: He will not be happy if he wakes up and finds that you are missing.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I promise, I won't be away for long. Please, give me a chance... a chance to do more, in order to enrich my soul.

steps.name: Composed Soldier
steps.text: Very well, but please be careful.

steps.name: Composed Soldier
steps.text: The city is currently taking in additional Infected. We cannot guarantee that these ruffians will not cause trouble.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I'll be careful.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please, my friend is in bad shape! I need to get medicine!

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: As I said, there is a strict curfew in place here.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Either you submit a request and wait for a decision, or hand the patient to us, and we'll transport her to receive treatment.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But you don't allow anyone to go with! There's no time, I have to—

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Not before sunrise. It's the rules.
Purr...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Now go back.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What that—in the bushes behind you?

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: That sort of trick won't work—
*roar*—!

steps.name: Voice from Communicator
steps.text: Target has been spotted in Naberezhnaya, near the Third District.

steps.name: Voice from Communicator
steps.text: Ponjal. Reinforcements are on their way.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Wait, is that really—

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Backup! I need backup!
The soldier quickly turns around and calls to his comrades near the building.
Amiya takes one last look at the shadow darting through the bushes, and takes off in the opposite direction.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Phew...)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (This was the busy street we saw during the day.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Hm—)

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: —I'm sorry, I'm sorry!

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: I got held up checking the boilers, I'll go home immediately—

steps.name: Robotic Voice
steps.text: You will be detained and fined for violation of curfew.

steps.name: Robotic Voice
steps.text: Do not attempt to resist.

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: Please, I have to go to work tomorrow—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (I have to avoid the searchlights. But why is there such a strict curfew here?)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (I hope I can find more medicine for Arts overload reactions...)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Raidian...)
The city of Zelgrad feels dark, even with lamps on both sides of the streets, as though neither the twin moons nor the stars shine upon it.
Amiya dashes along the side of the street, dodging the ever-present searchlights, looking up at the signs on the buildings.
*Whimper*

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's you... Are the people looking for you nearby? Why are they chasing you?
(Rubs against Amiya)
(Tugs at Amiya's skirt)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh... where are you taking me?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, I don't have time—
Purr!
The 'cloudbeast' in the shadows keeps tugging at Amiya's skirt, trying to pull her towards a nearby alley.
Looking in that direction, Amiya sees that there is an area of shadow that the searchlights do not touch.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I should check it out.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What is this...
A figure sits by the wall in the shadows beyond the searchlights' reach, hardly human anymore.
What little skin is visible through the bandages that almost completely cover his body shows a shade of eerie, translucent green.
Skin and muscle tissue on his arm are forming small clumps like moss and peeling off.
All he can do is wrap his arm in more bandages, as though hoping it will slow the departure of his skin and flesh.

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: (Hoarse wailing)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wh-What happened to you?

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Mur...

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Mur... where are you?
Purr...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mur? Is this its name?
The light from the searchlights finally allows Amiya to see the 'cloudbeast' clearly.

steps.name: Strange Creature
steps.text: *sniffles*—
The strange creature growls softly, as though confirming that Amiya has found the man, then disappears into the night.

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: I can't see... I can't see! Where are you, Mur?
The twisted figure stumbles towards her, his soggy flesh making a sickening sound underneath his bandages.
He does not realize that he would reveal himself to the searchlights if he took one step further. Amiya dashes forward and stops him.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Look out—!

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Who's there...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What... what's this sickness?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I-Is there any way I can help?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: My goodness, your arm...
Amiya catches the man as he collapses. He emanates the scent of a rotten bog as his limbs twitch.
It is the scent of death.

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Mur... Mulka!

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: All of you...

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: ...left me...

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Will never, see again.
Will never...
'Will never see again.'
In the man's confusion and pain, Amiya once again touches the emotion that causes her pain.
A black crown appears above her head.
As she touches his consciousness, she sees a small cabin, a woman and child who never returned after leaving home, a cloudbeast leaps from the window sill—
And a man who brought back a monster.

steps.name: Voice From Radio
steps.text: 'The collapse in the new industrial district caused nineteen deaths and thirty-four injuries at a nearby school.'

steps.name: Voice From Radio
steps.text: '...We express our deepest regrets for the accident. Compensation has been issued to those affected...'

steps.name: Familiar Man
steps.text: I won't open the window again, Mur. I won't give you another chance.
Purr?

steps.name: Familiar Man
steps.text: I won't open the door again...

steps.name: Familiar Man
steps.text: I won't open it for anyone.

steps.name: Familiar Man
steps.text: You and I will be the only ones here.

steps.name: Familiar Man
steps.text: Forever...

steps.name: Voice From Radio
steps.text: '...An experimental animal escaped from the industrial district. Anyone with information should call the Department of Livestock at 10103. A reward is being offered...'
Purr...

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: We'll never leave each other. They won't take anything else from me.

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Yes, that's it...

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Kirill!

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Kirill! Are you home?

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: I haven't seen you at the factory in a week. Are you alright?

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: If you are, go talk to the supervisor and get formal approval for leave, okay? They won't let me do it on your behalf—

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Kirill...

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: If you can hear me, remember that you can rely on us.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: We're a community, remember?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Your condition, 'Mur', and that voice outside the door—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's all this about...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Oh no, they found me!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (I must buy time, try to get this patient out from here.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (He's unconscious. I have to hurry—)

steps.name: Robotic Voice
steps.text: Target acquired.

steps.name: Robotic Voice
steps.text: Do not attempt to resist.

steps.name: Robotic Voice
steps.text: Third District patrols, in position.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (I can't get caught right now. I have to figure out what's going on with this man. This could be what Zelgrad is trying to hide—)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (I remember now. That woman at the transfer area was saying something about dust and infection. Now I see a patient with strange symptoms... yes...)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, I must—

steps.name: Robotic Voice
steps.text: Do not attempt to resist.

steps.name: Robotic Voice
steps.text: Do not—
You there! Follow me!
This way!

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: The streets are empty... but the underground is much busier.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Is this where the Infected was pointing me to?

steps.name: Busy Worker
steps.text: Go get help, we need extra hands—

steps.name: Busy Worker
steps.text: Oh. What are you doing here, kid?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Is something wrong?

steps.name: Busy Worker
steps.text: The pub owner Prokhor is dead! Looks like a robbery-murder. His body was found in the sewers. Who would have thought something like this could happen in Zelgrad?

steps.name: Busy Worker
steps.text: The sewer cleaners found him. We need more people to haul the body up, and then we'll report it in the morning...

steps.name: Busy Worker
steps.text: Oh, why am I even telling you this, just make way, I need to get help.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I'm no help when it comes to something like this... sorry.

steps.name: Busy Worker
steps.text: It's alright.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: (Is this where they found the body?)

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: (There's someone here...)

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Excuse me—

steps.name: Surprised Worker
steps.text: You found someone?

steps.name: Surprised Worker
steps.text: A kid? What are you doing here? Where are your parents? This is no place for you.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I would like to ask for directions. Can you point me to people who need help?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: People suffering from Oripathy, or other kinds of illness and pain...

steps.name: Surprised Worker
steps.text: Weird kid... I guess you're looking for a hospital? Someone in your family got sick or hurt?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Hospital...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: That works too.

steps.name: Surprised Worker
steps.text: Well, you'll only get arrested if you go outside now. But there's a place I can point you to if you need a doctor urgently...

steps.name: Surprised Worker
steps.text: She'll treat anyone, as long as you have money.
'Go out the steel door with a red circle on it, and take the path without street lamps or searchlights.'
'Keep going until you reach a wall. Crouch down and shove at the wall until you find a spot that's loose.'
'That's the door that leads to an abandoned factory, where you'll find the clinic and doctor you're looking for.'

steps.name: Suffering Infected
steps.text: Doctor... doctor...

steps.name: Suffering Infected
steps.text: Painkillers, please, give me painkillers! I'll give you all the factory scrips I have! I can't take it anymore, I can hear the rocks grow beneath my skin—

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: The doctor said not to rely on medicine until the pain reaches a certain threshold. It'll keep you from developing resistance too quickly, and make the meds last longer.

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: Just hang in there... we've got to get back to the factories after we get our meds for the day. You need to rest while you can.

steps.name: Suffering Infected
steps.text: I can't stand...

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: You're just imagining it! You're hurting so much that you can't feel anything. Let's see what degree of pain it corresponds to—

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: Hey, I think you're allowed meds now.

steps.name: Suffering Infected
steps.text: Quick, ask—ask for me!

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Please, allow me to help.

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Suffering Infected
steps.text: I don't care who you are, just help me—please!

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: What are you talking about? We don't even know who she is—
Hierda walks forward and takes the hands of the Infected on the stretcher in her own.
Tiny Originium grow from his ice-cold hands and legs. They can cause such lingering pain that death easily becomes preferable.

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: What are you doing? I'm calling for the doctor. Doctor! Doctor Nadezhda Pavlovna!

steps.name: Suffering Infected
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: Wait... your Originium is changing color?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I can't do much, but I can at least stop the pain.

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: ...Is he dead?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: No, I think—

steps.name: Suffering Infected
steps.text: What are you calling... dead...

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: Blyat! I thought—I thought you had gone to heaven already, you lucky bastard!

spans.text: I thought—I thought you had gone to heaven already, you lucky bastard!

steps.name: Suffering Infected
steps.text: It doesn't hurt anymore... thank you.

steps.name: Suffering Infected
steps.text: I don't know who you are or how you did it, but could you help that guy over there too?

steps.name: Suffering Infected
steps.text: I apologize on his behalf. He might be a rude mudak, but he was only worried about me.

spans.text: I apologize on his behalf. He might be a rude
, but he was only worried about me.

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: This is what I came for...
She speaks softly as she takes the other Infected's hand.
A warm, dazzling light surrounds the Infected. He feels himself rejuvenated and even stands up from the ground.

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: This is amazing... I got better all of a sudden! It's better than any medicine! How could this be?

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: What are you—

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: Oh, Doctor Nadezhda! I-I'm not saying your medicine's bad! Not at all!

steps.name: Optimistic Infected
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Doctor Nadezhda...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: (Is that the doctor the man in the underground layer was talking about?)
Hierda turns around to see that a door has opened at the end of the corridor.
The fluorescent white light of an operating room shines through the door, where a masked middle-aged woman wearing a white coat and gloves is standing.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Doctor...
The doctor shakes her head, wipes her hands with a towel and puts on her gloves again, before waving Hierda over.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: So you're that one they say removes people's pain with Arts.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: You know of me?

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: I thought you might come. I've already lost a bunch of patients thanks to you.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: You may have cured their ailment, but you've also cost me a large chunk of my income.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I thought you were a doctor...

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Does a doctor not need to eat? Besides, legally speaking, I'm not a doctor anymore. My license was revoked. I'm working unlicensed now.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: I'm trying to make enough money to get my license back. What do you think I should do with someone who's ruined my livelihood?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I regret it, but I can't just stand by and watch when there are patients who need my help.
Seeing the girl's nervous expression, the face beneath the mask seems to relax.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Just a bad attempt at a joke. Don't mind it. The atmosphere here is depressing enough as it is.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: But I am curious how you manage to do it. You have such incredible Arts, yet all you do is travel and preach like the Yurodstvo, without charging a single coin?

spans.text: curious how you manage to do it. You have such incredible Arts, yet all you do is travel and preach like the Yurodstvo, without charging a single coin?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I can't explain my powers... but please understand that I mean no harm.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Well, you certainly look cute, but I'm not in the habit of trusting someone who gives without asking for anything in return.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: What are you here for, little bunny?

steps.name: Frantic Infected
steps.text: Doctor Nadezhda! I have an emergency here!

steps.name: Frantic Infected
steps.text: Never seen this one before, but he's in bad shape—

steps.name: Frantic Infected
steps.text: Huh? You're here too, Hierda?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Oh... it's been a few days, hasn't it? You seem to be in better spirits now.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Enough chit-chat, let me see the patient.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Put on protective clothing immediately, Borislav, and prepare the surgery room.

steps.name: Borislav
steps.text: Gotcha!

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: ...Belay that, take a dose of metabolism inhibitor right now, and try to get in touch with Tonya.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: I'll deal with the surgery myself.
Hierda hears the patient's weak, pained cries as the bed is pushed past her.
She instinctively reaches out, hoping to give her usual help, but fails to give the patient any comfort.
Hierda follows the patient as he is pushed into the operating room, but she could do no more than let go of the hand in front of the operating room door.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank goodness...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Did you find this patient?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I should... thank you...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Just doing what I can... are you a doctor here?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The patient's condition is very unusual. It's not like any Oripathy I've seen before... I'm not even sure if it's Oripathy at all.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you know—

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: No, I'm not a doctor... I wish I was.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: But I can't heal them. What I can do is so limited...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, I got ahead of myself. I take it you are a cleric?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: It's alright, I didn't notice either... that you're so sick too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You mean my condition...? How can you tell?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: No, you're not like the others... you're very ill, but you're not seeking salvation, and I shouldn't do anything for you...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: But how do you endure it, when you carry so much pain with you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, I don't understand—
The diminutive Cautus casts her gaze towards the operating room.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I feel pain... a lot of pain.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I thought I didn't feel pain anymore, but I still feel such heavy pain when I see these people suffer...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Why... why does God make people suffer?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Why does she put such trials upon them... is suffering God's law?
Amiya is perplexed.
The Cautus before her seems even younger than her, but there is a sort of altruism with her that seems incongruent with her age.
Even without the black crown appearing, the Sarkaz King's power links Amiya's consciousness with her counterpart.
She does not sense any strong emotion, only a disjointed cloud, or a roiling ocean. The endless sorrow in the girl's consciousness threatens to swallow her.
Amiya is not willing to delve any further.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But my understanding is that this is not in line with Lateran law—sorry, I don't mean to offend your religion.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't think any suffering has to be inevitable. The pain imposed upon us is something that we should fight with all our strength.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: To help those who are suffering and defeat the ones inflicting the suffering... that's what we should do.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: But there are always people who can't be saved.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: There's always suffering, with no end in sight... does what we do really have meaning?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Do you not despair?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Perhaps.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I would have been crushed by despair, if I were on my own.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I'm never by myself, never have been...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Someone once told me of her dream, of her vision for this land... when people will overcome their differences, and Terra becomes a home for everyone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Her dream has inspired and united many people. I have borne witness to the legacy of that dream, and I'm certain that people will continue to carry it on.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't know how to completely eliminate suffering, of course. I suppose that's something only 'God' can do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There may be no end to suffering, but hope continues to live on.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: A home for everyone...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: How is he, doctor?

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Where did you find him?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: First District, in an alley by the factories.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: It's quite far from Kirill's home.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: He must have known that he didn't have long to live, and he didn't want to be found by people who knew him... poor Tonya is still looking for him.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you mean...?

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: I've done all I can, but his basic biological functions have completely failed... all I can do is mitigate his pain in some measure.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Is there anything we can do?

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Even the most miraculous Arts cannot reverse total failure of biological function.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: But feel free to try to ease his pain with your Arts, if he wakes up.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Did you find medicine, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just found a doctor. Give me a moment.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor Nadezhda, do you have medicine for Arts overload reactions here?

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Arts overload reaction? What are the symptoms? Weakness in the limbs, or brain fatigue?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She lost consciousness... we don't have enough emergency medicine. Can we get some from you?

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Lost consciousness? That sounds serious...

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: I can't just give you that sort of medicine without ascertaining the patient's condition. I'll come with you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Doctor—

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Metabolism inhibitor for you. I wasn't joking. Stay behind and help him, if you're willing.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: There's no obligation. If you don't want to help, you're free to leave on your own.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Borislav will be bringing Tonya over. She's been looking for the patient. There'll be someone taking care of him.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Oh, and... Amiya's the name, right? Take a dose of metabolism inhibitor, since you've been in contact with that patient. Not that it's much more than a placebo, given how little we know about this sickness.

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Alright, let's go.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: ...Wait!

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Amiya... that's your name, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: My name is... Hierda.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Maybe we'll meet again—

steps.name: Nadezhda
steps.text: Where is the patient? Lead the way.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: O-Okay—Sorry, Hierda...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: ...Will we meet again?
Hierda walks into the operating room after the others have left.
The disintegrating patient has been moved to a bed, surrounded by transparent tarp sheets as a temporary quarantine measure, making it hard to see clearly.
Hierda walks closer, and sees that the patient's chest continues to rise and fall underneath the new bandages.

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: You're awake? How are you feeling?

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: ...It hurts...

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: Help me... help me.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I-I can't end your pain. I tried, but I couldn't liberate you from your pain like I do with the others—

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Is there anything I can do to make you feel better?

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: Argh—ugh...

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: ...Kill...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: Kill...

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: Me.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Kill you...?

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: I can't see... Mulka.

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: My Mulka—

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: You can't get up—

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: *cough* *cough*!!

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: You need to stay still and conserve your strength. Using up your energy now will only make it hurt more later.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Do you need something? I'll help you.

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: I went to where we first met.

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: I saw you sitting there with a cloudbeast in your arms.

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: How strange, when you're already gone...

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: Argh—

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: What do I want...? I want to die...

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: Kill me. Don't give me any more hope.

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: Don't let her see me as I am now...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: No, maybe... maybe I can—
She cannot describe her sudden impulse. Does she want to fulfill his wish, or help him live on less painfully?
There is no act of resolve. Hierda simply reaches out again and places her hand upon his heaving chest.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: (I ask you to grant another wish.)

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: (May your blessings be upon all of us equally.)

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: (Even if Oripathy is not the reason for his pain, even if he could not know your name...)

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I hope, from the bottom of my heart, that you will be far from pain.
The skin, a sickly green covered in red blood, peels off like moss. The soft flesh beneath has hardened.
Orange rocks begin to replace what is left of the man. Hierda's eyes go wide; she has never seen a transformation like this before.
Finally, a small smile appears upon the patient's face.

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: ...If you see 'Mur'...

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: Help me...

steps.name: Strange Patient
steps.text: Thank him for his companionship.
What did you do?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I... I didn't—

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: I don't think I was seeing things.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: Please explain—what did you just do to this patient?
The young man deftly brushes the dead body to one side with his sword, takes a silk handkerchief from a servant, and begins to wipe away the blood from the blade.

steps.name: Anatoliy
steps.text: So, tell me...

steps.name: Anatoliy
steps.text: What do you mean when you say you don't know where she is?

steps.name: Brave Servant
steps.text: ...We sent someone to follow Gospozha Hierda, but we lost track of her after she entered the underground residential layer.

steps.name: Brave Servant
steps.text: We began searching for her immediately, and we have narrowed down the search to an illegal Infected squatter zone that we have been trying to eliminate.

steps.name: Brave Servant
steps.text: We believe that Gospozha Hierda went there to... perform her miracles.

steps.name: Anatoliy
steps.text: Perform her miracles... Hmph. Who told her she could hand out blessings like that? Does she think everyone deserves this salvation?

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Generalik! We found an illicit gathering in the Third District while pursuing the assassin!

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: These Infected are in violation of curfew, and attempting to resist arrest. They may be a diversion for the assassin—

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Your orders, sir?

steps.name: Brave Servant
steps.text: Both the Third District and the main urban area where Gospozha Hierda might be are not far from here.

steps.name: Anatoliy
steps.text: 'Might be'?

steps.name: Brave Servant
steps.text: ...In fact, we are certain she's there.

steps.name: Anatoliy
steps.text: Then we'll go to the Third District.

steps.name: Pavel
steps.text: It's too late... he's dead.

steps.name: Pavel
steps.text: We saw it! This girl used Arts on him, and then he died!
The youth gives Pavel a wave off.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: We do not wish to harm someone who is unarmed. We would appreciate it if you could provide us with information that demonstrates you are not hostile.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I didn't harm him... I just didn't want him to continue to be in pain.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: The doctor could not treat his condition, and I couldn't save his life.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: He was sick? What sort of illness?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I want to know too... I've never seen it before.
The youth steps forward to the side of the bed, carefully examining the dead patient's terrifying cadaver...
The expression does not change in the slightest.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: This validates our hypothesis. Whatever secret the Army is hiding in Zelgrad, it's killing the people here.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: Zelgrad is not paradise for the Infected. We must tell people the truth, and get them out of here.

steps.name: Pavel
steps.text: You're right, but how are we going to get the word out when we have a hard time getting the group together?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: You... want to take the people here away?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: I have friends here who will believe me... I can contact them, if you're willing to take them with you.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: We would love to be able to trust you, young lady, but how do you prove that you can be trusted?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: ...I can tell you about the Generalik's troop deployments here—

steps.name: Pavel
steps.text: What's happening?!

steps.name: Pavel
steps.text: We didn't alarm any soldiers on our way here!

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: Maybe somebody else caught their attention.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: No time for analysis. We pull out according to plan.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: As for you, young lady—

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: ...I'll come with you.
